productOnPage.title: Lullabies from Around Europe
productOnPage.author: Naomi Burrell
productOnPage.description: From the Creator: Naomi, Margareta and their friends have chosen music to help sooth you to sleep with a melting pot of folk tunes, classical music and poetry. So sit back and relax for the journey to the land of nod!  Meet the creator.This delightful second album of lullabies and night music from Naomi, Margareta and their Swedish friends will inspire your dreams and warm your soul. Relaxing you into a deep slumber through their rich collection of beautiful, European tunes, you will hear traditional lullabies in Swiss-German, Yiddish, German, French, Scots, and English, some translated poetry from Norway and even a spot of Shakespeare. The musicians improvised on their favourite melodies by Telemann, JC Bach, Bartok, Warlock, Schubert including a composition by Naomi and recorded it in a cosy studio in Gothenburg. Gentle spoken introductions paint scenes of moonlit skies, rustling leaves, sleepy animals, and drifting stars. A tender journey into the heart of night and the magic of dreams.Creators brings original audio from independent creators to Yoto: Get to know Naomi Burrell and check out our Q&A with the creator. Tracks included: Sicilienne Intro Furchte dich nicht Furchte dich nicht Intro Ruthenian Song Ruthenian Song Intro Bim Bam Bim Bam Intro Lune Pleine Lune Pleine Intro Ca' The Yowes Ca' The Yowes Intro Jupiter's Command  Jupiter's Command Intro Schlaf Chindli Schlaf Schlaf Chindli Schlaf Intro The Dream We Carry The Dream We Carry

**_From the Creator: Naomi, Margareta and their friends have chosen music to help sooth you to sleep with a melting pot of folk tunes, classical music and poetry. So sit back and relax for the journey to the land of nod! ._**

Meet the creator.  
  
  
  
  
This delightful second album of lullabies and night music from Naomi, Margareta and their Swedish friends will inspire your dreams and warm your soul. Relaxing you into a deep slumber through their rich collection of beautiful, European tunes, you will hear traditional lullabies in Swiss-German, Yiddish, German, French, Scots, and English, some translated poetry from Norway and even a spot of Shakespeare. The musicians improvised on their favourite melodies by Telemann, JC Bach, Bartok, Warlock, Schubert including a composition by Naomi and recorded it in a cosy studio in Gothenburg. Gentle spoken introductions paint scenes of moonlit skies, rustling leaves, sleepy animals, and drifting stars. A tender journey into the heart of night and the magic of dreams.  
  
  
  
  
Creators brings original audio from independent creators to Yoto: Get to know Naomi Burrell and check out our Q&A with the creator.

Tracks included:

*   Sicilienne

#### Who are Creators on Yoto?

Creators are independent audio makers bringing their original stories, games, songs and more to Yoto Cards. We hand-pick the best and freshest ideas — so every Creators Card meets the Yoto gold standard.

[Explore the Creators Collection](/creators/)

[Read Creator biographies](https://yoto.space/creator-profiles)
